title: Barron’s Ranks Evercore Wealth Management a Top 100 RIA Firm
summary: Evercore Wealth Management has once again been named to Barron’s annual ranking of the Top 100 Independent U.S. Registered Investment Advisors for 2026
body_markdown:
Evercore Wealth Management has once again been named to *Barron’s* annual ranking of the Top 100 Independent U.S. Registered Investment Advisors for 2026 (9/11/2026).


This recognition reflects the dedication of our colleagues and the trust our clients place in us. We remain focused on providing independent, personalized advice and delivering long-term value aligned with our clients’ goals.


To view the rankings, click[here](https://www.barrons.com/advisor/report/top-financial-advisors/ria?page=1) .
